name: Sacañet (Spain)
description: Tierced per bend sinister red, yellow and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sacañet (a tree between two crosses on yellow).
history: The flag was approved by resolution of 20 February 2002 of the conseller de Justícia i Administracions Públiques, published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat Valenciana no. 4220 of 3 April 2002; it is a flag of 2:3, tierced per bend sinister; Sacañet belonged to the municipality of Bejís until 1842.
